technical_error_handling: Abort and retain diagnostics. A timeout/error is not a scored defeat in this practice build.
clock: Both policies observe the same pre-decision state. Game advances only after both return. Action frame plans are exactly six native frames.
decision_timeout_note: 2 seconds is a generous engineering watchdog, NOT the previous course one-frame deadline or an approved competition latency limit.
score: Report KO/native-timeout wins/losses/draws. A safety frame cap is a separate cutoff. Never use a student's reward as the match score.
security: Separate processes and checksums are NOT a sandbox. Review custom Python/models. Formal untrusted competition needs OS/container/VM isolation, no network and no secrets.
course_approval: The supplied old guide restricts Ryu and states a one-frame decision deadline and .pth/act(state) submission. Flexible characters, this six-frame protocol and the new ZIP format require instructor approval.
